entities.summary: Caterina Fake is an American entrepreneur and investor. She co-founded the websites Flickr in 2004 and Hunch in 2007. Fake is a trustee for nonprofit organizations and served as the chairwoman of Etsy. For her role in creating Flickr, Fake was listed in Time magazine's Time 100, and she has been recognized within Silicon Valley for her work as an angel investor.
